cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Call It a Fair Win
cards.instruction: Get them to recognize the result as deserved rather than accidental, gifted, or manipulated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Say I earned the quiz trophy, not that the questions suited me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There were a lot of bird questions.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

mechanism: Copy a buzzer test as quiz technique, then demand that a lucky result be publicly described as earned.
confusable: Not informed boasting: B2 identifies copied testing, while A3/A5 turn premature buzzing and guessing into preparation.
comparison: Public trophy wording differs from defending racing conduct.
seedUse: Retains quiz trophy/bird/luck dispute from canonical Drive; introduces the buzzer-test misunderstanding.
